intro: Hammertoe Grez, nursing wounds, sends you with the amulet to Prospector Ryedol in the Badlands. Ryedol knows what Hammertoe was seeking, and what the Shadowforge clan must not be allowed to find.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hammertoe holds his wounds and takes a moment to regain his composure before speaking again.

Find Ryedol, friend. Bring 'im me amulet. He'll... Figure out what to do. He knows I was seeking the origins of our people, and he...... Knows it was also my mission to stop the Shadowforge clan. They must not be allowed to find the scrolls...

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'd say it was a bad day, but this is the Badlands: every day's a bad day.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hammertoe's amulet? I think my spirits were higher when I thought he was dead. Knowin' fer sure only makes the pain worse. This amulet was his life's work. I can't let his death be in vain.
